output.reason: [ev-cd857bf3470c] is only a one-line PR title and doesn't say what is merged, how, or what differed before. The same release section shows that MRDs are new in this release: [ev-47653e3e1ebb] adds the ManagedResourceDefinition type, [ev-543a22471270] adds the MRD reconciler and [ev-de4d43e22a68] moves the MRD API to v1alpha1. So this reads as in-release development of a new feature, not a change to behavior that existed in an earlier release, and "behavior-changed" is not supported. Merging MRD definitions is also not wire or protocol behavior, so protocol-behavior is the wrong family, and the evidence names no other typed subject that a correction could use.
